User Guide

Getting Started

Select File

Click the accented folder icon in the top right to load an audio file from your device.

Precision Trimming

Capture (Pin)

Click the thumbtack icon next to Start or End points to instantly set them to the current playhead position.

Fine-Tuning

Use « / » to jump 1 second, and ‹ / › to adjust by 100ms for frame-perfect cuts.

Focused Previews

Each card has a play button. The End Point preview plays only the last 2 seconds of your clip for a quick check.

Validation

If an input field turns RED, it means the time is invalid (e.g., exceeds track length or Start is after End).

Saving

Give your clip a name and hit Download Clip. Your high-quality WAV file will be generated instantly in your browser.

Error

Something went wrong.
